# Filename Convention

Use this format for experiment files:

`YYYY-MM-DD_subject_condition_trial_modality.ext`

Examples:
- `2026-03-04_S01_NVGVS_T01_oculus.csv`
- `2026-03-04_S01_NVGVS_T01_forceplate.mat`
- `2026-03-04_S01_NVGVS_T01_arduino.csv`

Rules:
- Use ISO date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- Keep subject IDs de-identified (`S01`, `S02`, ...).
- Conditions should be controlled vocabulary (`NV`, `VGVS`, `NVGVS`, etc.).
- Trial IDs use fixed width (`T01`, `T02`, ...).
- Use lowercase modality names (`oculus`, `forceplate`, `arduino`).
